newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Soda up on DRAM material production plans.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Soda up on DRAM material production plans.

text.p: Nippon Soda Co Ltd gained on Tuesday on news that it would start production of a material to make photo-resist for 256-megabit dynamic random access memories (DRAMs), brokers said.
The share ended 14 yen higher at 989 yen, with 2.238 million shares traded. It was the 13th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Photo-resist is an essential material for semiconductor production.

A company spokesman said on Tuesday that the firm would invest two to three billion yen to set up production facilities to produce Poly P-Hydroxystyrene at one of its subsidiaries in Chiba Prefecture, near Tokyo.
